rejectedSkills.reason: Frontmatter has name=wireframe-sketch matching dirname, license (repo-root Apache-2.0) is clean, and the 2-file directory (SKILL.md + example.html) is self-contained with no external relative links. But this is not a portable agent skill: SKILL.md is an 8-line Chinese-language style-preset spec (grid background + marker strokes + sticky notes + hand-drawn font stack) with no actionable workflow, no steps, no output-format guidance — it reads as an internal design-token/style card consumed programmatically by html-anything's own template-selection pipeline. Non-spec frontmatter fields (zh_name, en_name, emoji, category, scenario, aspect_hint, recommended) are not cosmetic: aspect_hint/recommended/scenario are used by the host app's own template ranking and prompt-assembly logic, i.e. host-specific coupling beyond the six-field skill spec. example.html embeds a data-od-id=... marker convention specific to html-anything's own editor/preview tooling. Total rubric score 5 < 6 threshold; reject rather than not-vendored-keeper since the blocker is quality/conformance, not license or an unresolved external dependency.
